# Summary

We have done a very quick overview of basic statistical methods and R programming.

In the section on statistical methods, we have discussed:

- how to summarize and compare continuous outcomes in 2 group settings,
- how to summarize and compare binary outcomes in 2 group settings,
- what p-values and confidence intervals are, and 
- how to select statistical methods for these simple cases.

The section on analysis using R 

- showed how to run basic checks of key features of a dataset, 
- gave examples of data cleaning using functions from `dplyr`,
- showed how to make a participant descriptive table using `tbl_summary`,
- made some plots of outcomes by treatment using `ggplot2`, 
- ran regression models and showed their coefficients using `tbl_regression`, and
- showed key functions for importing data.

All examples are accompanied by R code that can be used to try out these methods.
